description: This plot illustrates the MRR@10 of different DPR models with various query selection strategies against the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis represents the number of queries used during inference (S), with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents MRR@10, with a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot compares six different DPR models: DPR w/o query (black), DPR w/ gold (yellow), DPR w/ top-1 (green), DPR w/ bottom-1 (purple), DPR w/ random (blue), and DPR w/ curriculum (red), each represented by a distinct line style and color. The DPR w/ gold line starts at approximately 33.1 at S=1, increases to around 33.2 at S=4, and then rises to about 35.0 at S=10. The DPR w/ top-1 line begins at roughly 34.3 at S=1, sharply increases to around 35.7 at S=4, and continues to rise to approximately 36.4 at S=10. The DPR w/ random line starts at about 34.8 at S=1, slightly increases to around 35.4 at S=4, and remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 35.3 at S=10. The DPR w/ curriculum line begins at around 35.4 at S=1, increases to about 35.7 at S=4, and remains steady, ending at approximately 35.7 at S=10. The DPR w/ bottom-1 line starts at about 34.9 at S=1, remains relatively stable until S=6, and then gradually declines to approximately 34.7 at S=10. The DPR w/o query is represented by a solid black line at a constant MRR@10 of around 34.4. Each model's dotted line represents its performance with the typical representation, remaining constant across the x-axis, with values ranging from approximately 34.4 to 35.7.
